jsonld_raw.name: ELEGANTLY TOKYO HAND CREAM 50ML (1.69 FL.OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
A scented hand cream featuring the Elegantly Tokyo fragrance. Perfectly paired with the Eau de Parfum for a more tactile olfactory experience. Inspired by the balance between tradition and modernity that defines Tokyo, this fragrance blends the luminosity of white flowers and jasmine with the contemporary depth of akigalawood.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Floral | Serene, luminous, and structured
